STD-TEXT@login.line: harness check: untranslated under system locale
STD-TEXT@login.conclusion: STD-TEXT switches the Android per-app locale, but the app takes its language from the in-app setting, so ru/uz never applied (screens stayed English). Translations exist: switching ru/uz in Profile -> Language shows Russian/Uzbek on login. ru/uz layout at 1.15 and en at 2.0 not judged. Standards harness needs an in-app language hook.
